channel.title: NET Law-Verse Blog
channel.description: UGC NET Law (058), Paper 1, CLAT PG, AILET LLM and AIBE exam updates, legal current affairs and study guides.

item.title: Arbitration Rulings 2026: Pre-Deposit, Seat, Appointment
item.description: Arbitration rulings 2026 explained: 10% pre-deposit reference, unilateral appointment under Article 14, seat with two venues, non-signatories, Section 9 fraud.

item.title: Compensation for Custodial Violence: 2026 Rulings
item.description: 2026 custodial violence rulings: Lahra Bai Tamre (CBI probe, Rs 25 lakh), Daudayal, Hari Dutta Sharma and Suda Suresh, explained for Article 21.

item.title: Unpaid E-Challans: Supreme Court Impound Order 2026
item.description: S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India (2026): Supreme Court directs States to impound vehicles with unpaid e-challans. Due process and Motor Vehicles Act explained.

item.title: Grounds of Arrest in Writing: Jaskaran Deol 2026
item.description: Jaskaran Deol (2026): arrest without written grounds is illegal under Article 22(1), no prejudice needed. Release, re-arrest and compensation rules explained.

item.title: GST Arrest Rules: Sunil Biyani Ruling 2026
item.description: Sunil Biyani (2026): GST arrest under Section 69 needs a communicated order and reasons to believe; no arrest to force ITC reversal. Bail rules explained.

item.title: Madrasah Staff Appointments: Najma Khatun Ruling 2026
item.description: Najma Khatun (2026): Supreme Court dismisses 49 petitions by madrasah staff appointed after its 2016 stay. Why irregular public appointments fail, explained.

item.title: MMDR Amendment Act 2026: State Mineral Taxes Explained
item.description: MMDR Amendment Act 2026 explained: new Section 9D limits State taxes on mineral rights, deems past levies invalid and responds to MADA v. SAIL (2024).

item.title: Monsoon Session 2026: All New Acts Explained
item.description: Monsoon Session 2026 Acts in one place: Tribunals Reforms, Public Examinations, Births and Deaths, Keralam, MMDR, MSME and more, with exam notes.

item.title: Speedy Trial: 23-Year FERA Case Quashed (2026)
item.description: Standard Chartered FERA case (2026): 23-year-old complaint quashed under Article 21; Section 61(2) FERA opportunity notice held mandatory.

item.title: Spurious Liquor Rules Struck Down: Balaji Formalin 2026
item.description: Balaji Formalin (2026): Supreme Court strikes down Maharashtra Poisons Rules 18A and 18B on methanol. Proportionality, Article 14, hooch guidelines.

item.title: APAAR ID Supreme Court 2026: Student Data and Consent
item.description: Supreme Court upholds the APAAR ID scheme in 2026 but requires an opt-out in the consent form and limits disclosure of student data.

item.title: Bail and Custody Rulings 2026: Key Supreme Court Updates
item.description: Bail and custody rulings of 2026: undertrials with bail orders still jailed, deemed suspension after 48 hours, morality-based bail denial and NSA quashed.

item.title: CEC Appointment Law 2023: Why It Went to a Constitution Bench
item.description: Challenge to the CEC and Election Commissioners Appointment Act, 2023 referred to a Constitution Bench in 2026.

item.title: Civil Judge Exam: 3-Year Practice Rule Changed in 2026
item.description: Bhumika Trust (2026): Supreme Court replaces the 3-year Bar practice rule for Civil Judge with 1 year plus training and clerkship. Eligibility explained.

item.title: Constitution 131st Amendment Bill 2026: Why It Failed
item.description: The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 on women's reservation and delimitation failed in the Lok Sabha.

item.title: Court Live-Stream Clips Ban 2026: Supreme Court Explained
item.description: Supreme Court limits extracting, posting and monetising court proceeding recordings in 2026. Harshita Grover case, open court and Article 19 explained.

item.title: CUET PG LLM Admission Process: Scorecard, Merit List and Counselling
item.description: CUET PG LLM admission process after the result: scorecard, university forms, merit lists, counselling, documents and what a good score means.

item.description: CUET PG LLM 2027 eligibility, age limit, final-year rule, application fee and registration timeline. As per NTA's 2026 bulletin; 2027 bulletin expected in December.

item.title: CUET PG LLM Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme: 75 Questions, +4 and -1
item.description: CUET PG LLM exam pattern: 75 MCQs, 300 marks, +4 and -1 marking, 90 minutes, English and Hindi. How to attempt the paper and avoid negative marking.

item.description: CUET PG LLM paper analysis for 2024 to 2026: difficulty, subject-wise question estimates, question types, candidate numbers and the topics and cases that repeat.

item.description: CUET PG LLM syllabus 2027 (COQP14): 30-plus law subjects from Constitution to International Trade, grouped as core, regular and occasional with topics to study.

item.title: Death by Hanging Upheld: Rishi Malhotra Ruling 2026
item.description: Rishi Malhotra v. Union of India (2026): Supreme Court keeps hanging, refuses to revisit Deena (1983) and finds lethal injection not shown to be more humane.

item.title: Digital Arrest Scams: Supreme Court Directions 2026
item.description: Supreme Court's August 2026 directions on digital arrest scams: RBI SOP for debit holds, money restoration, e-Zero FIR, CBI threshold and compensation.

item.title: District Judges Retirement Age 62: Supreme Court 2026 Order
item.description: Supreme Court directs seven states to raise district judges' retirement age from 60 to 62 in 2026. Articles 233 to 237 and the rejoining option explained.

item.title: Early Release for Elderly and Terminally Ill Prisoners 2026
item.description: Supreme Court orders a premature release policy for prisoners over 70 or terminally ill in NALSA v. Union of India (2026).

item.title: Electronic Evidence 2026: Section 63 BSA, Bankers' Books Bill
item.description: Electronic evidence in 2026: Supreme Court upholds Section 63(4) BSA certificate, Part B expert certification open, and the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill 2026.

item.title: FCRA Amendment Bill 2026: Key Functionaries, Asset Vesting
item.description: FCRA Amendment Bill 2026 explained: key functionaries, asset vesting in a Designated Authority, one-year jail cap, prior approval for probes, JPC referral.

item.title: Front-of-Pack Food Warning Labels: Supreme Court 2026
item.description: Supreme Court pushes FSSAI on front-of-pack warning labels for high sugar, salt and fat foods (2026). Article 21, Article 47 and the right to know.
